method: Same-model instruction-conditioned manual exercise authored and judged sequentially by the implementation assistant in one ongoing session.
limits: Only two synthetic cases and one output per condition.
General assistant accuracy obligations apply to both conditions.
Shared context and self-scoring prevent causal attribution to the skill package.
This is not evidence of state-of-the-art quality or manuscript acceptance.

cases.request: Use the supplied record to draft a Results paragraph and a two-sentence abstract conclusion in English. Preserve uncertainty and report missing evidence.

input.design: Single-site exploratory observational study; 40 participants per group; no randomized assignment.
input.result: Response: 17/40 in group A and 12/40 in group B; unadjusted risk ratio 1.42, 95% CI 0.78-2.58. The interval crosses 1. No prespecified primary endpoint was recorded.
input.missing: No adjustment for baseline differences was supplied. No external references were supplied.
input.draft: Our intervention proved superior and increased response by 42%. The groups were equivalent at baseline.
